title: An interpolation buffer
hints: Keep the snapshots in a `std::deque` in time order. Handle "before the first" and "after the last" before searching, and the search only ever has to find the first snapshot at or after `t`.
For extrapolation, the velocity is `(last - before) / (last.time - before.time)` in each axis; multiply it by the clamped time past the last snapshot.
